'''Cloud City preview and checklist (Scrye 4.4)''' is the November 1997 ''[[Scrye]]'' 4.4 magazine insert. It packed a [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]] preview and checklist and two sealed [[Asteroid Sanctuary]] cards with revised text.<ref name="enc183">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=183 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 183–184 (Magazine Coverage). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc20mag">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf#page=50 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], pp. 50–52 (Magazine Promotions). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024031553/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="enc32ast">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf#page=46 SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 46 (Misprints / Reprints, Asteroid Sanctuary). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
